caption: The video captures a yellow press head with a chrome cylindrical piston banded by a yellow ring, held centered above a yellow platform inside a black chamber framed by hazard stripes. On the platform lies a transparent block already shattered into a vertical column of broken pieces directly beneath the piston. A dense cloud of fine dust and countless clear fragments fills the surrounding air. The piston and platform stay fixed while the airborne shards drift outward and downward, tumbling and rotating toward the edges. The left and right fragment clusters spread farther apart and sink, and the dust haze slowly thins as particles settle toward the platform. The central column of larger pieces stays roughly in place, shifting only slightly as smaller bits fall away.
relations: With the piston and platform fixed, airborne shards drift outward and downward toward the edges.
As shards settle toward the platform, the dense dust haze slowly thins in the surrounding air.
Despite smaller bits falling away, the central column of larger pieces remains roughly in place.
